:9/$2U}-C@{Ye,sdmBY2.text:
Charting method (OLD)

How to record:
* You must set the "isRecording?" variable to 1 (Don't press the green flag or else it will set back to 0), so when you press the keys, it will start recording every chart. This uses the scratch's timer

Record keys:
D and F: These keys are used to set a new note for the opponent, one note
S: This key generates a lot of notes for the opponent, between 0.05 seconds (Used for charts that needs a lot of notes)
J and K: As the normal keys for the opponent, this keys are used to set a new note for the player
L: As the same the key "S", but for the player

Start recording:
* Download the song that you want to set and replace the name with the challenge, ex: challenge6.1
* Look for a block that has a label named "The old record method", set the variables on the top as you like. When you're ready, press it
* Then when the song starts, you can now start pressing the keys and it will record on the lists

To make sure if it was recording, check the lists "songCharting", "songTimestamps" and "songLengths" and see if at the bottom of the lists are the new charts added

If there's an error, please tell me about it. It will help me to improve
